title: More Secure Software Development via Cultural Analysis: How could Log4Shell happen?
abstract: arXiv:2611.18565v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: There is little progress avoiding vulnerabilities. Cultural analysis may help: For a given team, find the specific cultural values that led to a past vulnerability, then modify the values accordingly for the future. After enough such studies, patterns will likely emerge that are useful for the development community at large.
